inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Instagram DMs plus Gmail and Outlook email in one place. AI suggests; you decide what gets sent.

notConfiguredHint.instagram: Instagram messages aren't turned on yet.
notConfiguredHint.gmail: The Gmail connection isn't turned on yet.
notConfiguredHint.outlook: The Outlook connection isn't turned on yet.

inbox.igNeedsAccount: First connect your Instagram professional account in Accounts.
inbox.tiktokSoon: TikTok has no public direct-message API. We'll add it as soon as an official option exists.
inbox.disconnectConfirm: Access will be removed and this account's threads, messages and drafts will be deleted from Kreo. The originals stay on the platform.
inbox.disconnectConfirmOutlook: Threads, messages and drafts will be deleted from Kreo. To also remove the permission at Microsoft, go to account.microsoft.com → Privacy → Apps with access (or ask your Microsoft 365 admin).
inbox.connectedOk: {channel} connected. We're pulling in your recent conversations.

emptyNoConnections.title: Connect your first channel
emptyNoConnections.body: Under “Channels” above, turn on Instagram DMs or connect Gmail or Outlook. We only read recent conversations and you only reply to existing threads.

emptyList.replied: You haven't replied to any conversation yet.
emptyList.hint: We show the last 30 days. Tap ↻ on a channel to sync.

selectThread.title: Pick a conversation
selectThread.body: Read the thread, ask the AI for a draft if you like, and send the reply yourself.

inbox.retention: Kreo keeps message content for 30 days and then deletes it automatically. Marking as read or archiving only affects Kreo, not Gmail, Outlook or Instagram.
inbox.noMessages: This thread's messages have expired (older than 30 days).

window.open: 24-hour window open: you can reply until {time}.
window.humanAgent: More than 24 h have passed. You're replying as a human agent (Meta's exception for replies from people) until {time}. Only replies written or reviewed by a person.
window.closed: More than 24 h have passed since their last message. Instagram doesn't let apps reply outside that window: reply from the Instagram app or wait until they message you again.
window.closedHumanAgent: More than 7 days have passed since their last message. Instagram doesn't let apps reply: reply from the Instagram app or wait until they message you again.

inbox.connectionInactive: This account's connection has expired. Reconnect it to reply.

composer.viewerNote: Your role is read-only: an editor can reply.
composer.label: Your reply
composer.aiDraftNote: AI-suggested draft. Review and edit it: it's only sent when you press Send.
composer.humanNote: It's only sent when you press Send.
composer.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. offer 10% off and ask for the order number
composer.aiNotConfigured: AI suggestions aren't turned on yet. You can write the reply yourself.
composer.sendNote: You reply in the same thread, to the original sender. No bulk sending.

errors.not_configured: This channel isn't turned on yet.
errors.invalid_state: The connection expired or is invalid. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this project.
errors.missing_scopes: Some permissions are missing. Reconnect and accept all requested permissions.
errors.no_matching_account: We couldn't find that Instagram account among the authorized pages. Make sure it's the same account connected in Accounts.
errors.profile_failed: We couldn't identify the connected mailbox.
errors.token_exchange_failed: The platform rejected the connection. Try again.
errors.subscribe_failed: We couldn't turn on Instagram message notifications. Make sure the account allows message access (Settings → Messages → Connected tools).
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The platform isn't responding. Try again later.
errors.too_long: The message is too long for Instagram (max 1,000 characters).
errors.no_recipient: There's no valid address to reply to in this thread.
errors.no_inbound: You can only reply to conversations where the other person has written to you.
errors.connection_inactive: The connection has expired. Reconnect it.
errors.token_expired: Access expired or was revoked. Reconnect the account.
errors.missing_tokens: Access to this account is missing. Reconnect it.
errors.send_failed: The platform didn't accept the message. It wasn't sent.
errors.missing_page: The linked Facebook Page is missing. Reconnect.
errors.refusal: The AI couldn't suggest a reply for this message. Write it yourself.
errors.provider_error: The AI isn't available right now. You weren't charged.

studioAudio.notConfigured: Voice and music aren't turned on yet.
studioAudio.textPlaceholder: Your sensitive skin deserves ingredients you understand. Meet our oat serum…
studioAudio.musicPlaceholder: Warm lo-fi for a product video, 90 BPM, soft piano and laid-back drums
studioAudio.musicHint: Describe style, tempo and instruments. Don't ask to imitate specific artists or copyrighted lyrics.
studioAudio.termsTitle: Terms of use for the output
studioAudio.termsVoice: You can use voice-overs in your commercial content. Only voices from ElevenLabs' default library: don't imitate real people. The audio is labelled as AI-generated.
studioAudio.termsMusic: Commercial use online and offline (social, ads, web). Excludes film, TV, radio and studio video games. The track is C2PA-signed and labelled as AI-generated.

errors.not_configured: Audio generation isn't turned on yet.
errors.invalid_voice: That voice is no longer available. Pick another.
errors.banned_word: The text includes a word banned in your brand kit.
errors.provider_error: ElevenLabs couldn't generate the audio. Your credits were refunded.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to generate in this project.

studioAudio.generatingMusic: Composing the track… this can take up to 2 minutes.

clipper.title: Clipper
clipper.subtitle: Upload one of your long videos and get vertical shorts with captions. AI proposes the moments; you choose.

youtube.title: From a YouTube link
youtube.body: YouTube's official API doesn't allow downloading videos, so we won't. Download your video from YouTube Studio and upload it here.

empty.title: Upload your first long video
empty.body: Podcast, livestream, tutorial or talk. We transcribe the audio, AI proposes the best moments and you generate the shorts you pick.

upload.title: New video
upload.body: MP4 up to 50 MB and 60 min (current storage limit). If it's bigger, export it at 720p.
upload.rights: I confirm this is my own content or that I have the rights to edit and publish it.
upload.rightsHint: Don't upload other creators' videos, TV broadcasts or third-party copyrighted music: platforms may remove the clips and penalise your account.
upload.costHint: Pick a video to see the cost.

clipper.deleteConfirm: Delete this analysis? The original video and generated shorts stay in the library.

progress.transcribing: Transcribing the audio… usually 1–5 minutes. You can close the page: we keep going in the background.
progress.analyzing: AI is picking the best moments…

clipper.noMoments: We couldn't find clear moments in this video. Try one with more dialogue.
clipper.momentsHint: Moments proposed by AI, ranked by potential within this video. Review each one, adjust the timing if needed and choose which to turn into shorts.
clipper.subtitles: Burned-in captions in your brand colours
clipper.subtitlesHint: Karaoke style: the word being spoken is highlighted in the closest brand colour. If you turn it off, download the .srt and upload it as captions on the platform.
clipper.renderHint: Each short is trimmed, reframed to 9:16 (1080×1920, centre crop) and saved to the library ready to schedule. Check the framing: if you're off-centre you may get cut off.
clipper.render: {n, plural, =0 {Generate shorts} one {Generate # short} other {Generate # shorts}}
clipper.scoreHint: Relative potential within this video (0–100). Not a view prediction.
clipper.previewMoment: Preview of the moment in the original video
clipper.renderFailed: This short couldn't be generated. Your credits were refunded; you can try again.

errors.only_mp4: MP4 only for now (it's the format transcription supports). Export it as MP4 (H.264).
errors.too_big: The video is larger than 50 MB. Export it at 720p or trim it.
errors.too_long: The video is longer than 60 minutes.
errors.too_short: The video is too short to clip (min 20 s).
errors.no_duration: We couldn't read the video's length. Try exporting it again as MP4.
errors.upload_failed: The video couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this project.
errors.provider_error: The video service isn't available. Your credits were refunded.
errors.no_speech: We didn't detect speech in the video.
errors.duration_mismatch: The video's real length doesn't match the one read at upload.
errors.analysis_failed: The AI couldn't analyse the transcript.
errors.bad_range: Each short must last 10–90 seconds and be within the video.
errors.busy: Wait for the current process to finish.
